title: WebGPU PBR Textures in Rust: Cerberus Materials and IBL
description: Render a textured Cerberus model with WebGPU and Rust using albedo, normal, AO, metallic, and roughness maps, GGX lighting, and image-based lighting.
imageAlt: An ornate black, brass, and wood Cerberus triple-barrel pistol rendered against a sunlit bridge cubemap beside PBR controls.
